attr.title: retsend
attr.desc: Transfer files between handheld and your phone or PC over wifi, using the LocalSend (https://localsend.org) protocol — no cable, no SSH.
attr.desc_md: Transfer files between handheld and your phone or PC over wifi, using the [LocalSend](https://localsend.org) protocol — no cable, no SSH.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Install LocalSend (localsend.org) on your phone or PC, connect both devices to the same wifi, and they will find each other.
attr.inst_md: Ready to run. Install [LocalSend](https://localsend.org) on your phone or PC, connect both devices to the same wifi, and they will find each other.
